escenas: Welcome to your new adventure! We are James the First of Aragon and María of Castile — delighted to be your guides on this treasure hunt through Valencia.
One small thing before you set off: make sure GPS and internet are switched on, and grant any permissions your device asks for.
We have several adventures lined up for you. Each one has its own distance, duration and a suggested way to get around. Pick the one that suits you best.
Your full adventure at a glance: numbered stops, a mapped-out route — and the whole city waiting to be explored.
Here are the buttons that will power your adventure. Let's go through them one by one.
This button shows you the full route of your adventure and all the key stops along the way.
The same map — but with a soul all of its own. A vintage style that takes you centuries back in time. Which do you prefer?
Stop by stop, the city reveals its wonderful treasures as the adventure unfolds around you. This button switches on and off automatically — always keeping pace with you.
Coming up on a new stop? Tap this button for a quick look at the photo so you can spot the place straight away.
Rather see where you're heading before you get there? Tap this button for a short video guide to the next stop. You can watch it again any time to stay on track.
En Busca del Tesoro is an audio-guided, interactive experience designed to help you discover the city while you play. Use this button to listen to the commentary in the language of your choice.
When this button lights up, the fun takes it up a notch. Puzzles, riddles and challenges are waiting for you.
Not all questions are as simple as they look. Some are multiple choice — and more than one answer may be correct. Read carefully, look around you and think before you tap!

Valencia deserves to be savoured. Stop for a photo, take a rest, explore the recommended spot… There's no rush. Wander the streets, unravel the mysteries and discover the city's heritage at your own pace. Let's make history an experience worth remembering.
Lost your way? Wandered too far from the planned route? Don't worry — this button will activate automatically to show you how to get back on track. Just tap it when it lights up.

Even the greatest adventures deserve a well-earned rest. If you need to take a break and come back later, this button will activate automatically to show you how to return right where you left off. Tap it whenever you feel ready.
Every adventure has an estimated finish time. Check how much time has passed here whenever you like.
If you have any questions during your Adventure, tap this button at any time to access our frequently asked questions — we work hard to make your experience as comfortable and smooth as possible.
All set. Valencia is waiting — with its monuments, its secrets and its challenges. Let the adventure begin!
Tap this button to check your adventure's progress — use it whenever you need to know how many stops you have left to finish.
